notes: CardDemo's main menu (CM00, COMEN01C) on a GENERATED map input (#4506): 30 scenarios whose COMMAREA is generated and whose RECEIVE MAP input is typed for COMEN01's one unprotected field, OPTION (NUM, 2 bytes), over options 1 to 12 (0, blank and 13 to 99 index past the table, which register X8 refuses, so those stay in carddemo-menu as the named bounds_refused scenarios option-zero / option-blank); the key pressed turns through ENTER, PF3, PF5 and PF12. Proves the carddemo-menu port on inputs it was not written against; the hand-written scenarios left are fault runs. scenarios.name: no-commarea
scenarios.why: #4506: no COMMAREA, which a generated COMMAREA never leaves out

scenarios.name: option-11-not-installed
scenarios.why: #4506: the fault run of carddemo-menu (INQUIRE PROGRAM raises PGMIDERR), which generated inputs do not reach

scenarios.name: option-1-xctl-fails
scenarios.why: #4506: the fault run of carddemo-menu (XCTL raises PGMIDERR), which generated inputs do not reach

scenarios.name: option-9
scenarios.why: #4506 (mutation survivors of the generated variant): a one-digit option 9 (the draw never sends 9 on ENTER with context 1)

scenarios.name: option-10
scenarios.why: #4506 (mutation survivors of the generated variant): option 10: a second digit 0 and the tenth table entry's program (COBIL00C)

scenarios.name: option-past-the-table
scenarios.why: #4506 (mutation survivors of the generated variant): option 12: past the 11 installed options, inside the 12-entry table

scenarios.name: option-right-justified
scenarios.why: #4506 (mutation survivors of the generated variant): an option typed in the first column ('3 ')

scenarios.name: last-map-carried
scenarios.why: #4506 (mutation survivors of the generated variant): a COMMAREA whose last map and mapset are set, as the sign-on leaves them

scenarios.name: carried-commarea-fields
scenarios.why: #4506 (mutation survivors of the generated variant): non-blank TO-TRANID, TO-PROGRAM, CUST-LNAME and ACCT-STATUS in the input COMMAREA reach the XCTL

scenarios.name: option-12-typed-over
scenarios.why: #4506 (mutation survivors of the generated variant): an invalid option 12 with the twelfth option line received, which the 11-entry menu never rewrites before the re-send

scenarios.name: option-non-numeric
scenarios.why: #4506 (mutation survivors of the generated variant): a non-digit option, which the generator's typed NUM field never sends
